# elemento Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) The Elemento API host. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_HOST environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The Elemento API password. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `portal` (String) The Elemento API portal. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_PORTAL environment variable.
- `username` (String) The Elemento API username. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_USERNAME environment variable.
